metadata.question: Were the mean tropospheric nitrogen dioxide levels higher over Shanghai than over Wuhan during April 20-May 12, 2020?

data.raw_code:
<thinking>
1. Search strategy: Use Sentinel-5P TROPOMI NO2 L3 datasets over Shanghai and Wuhan for 2020-04-20 to 2020-05-13 (end exclusive). Primary: COPERNICUS/S5P/OFFL/L3_NO2; fallback: COPERNICUS/S5P/NRTI/L3_NO2; final fallback widens dates.
2. Masking strategy: Apply recommended QA mask using qa_value >= 0.75. Not a cloud question; focus on valid pixels count.
3. Logic: Check collection size; if 0, try fallbacks; if still 0, C1. After masking, count valid pixels per city; if any city has 0, C2. Compute mean NO2; if null/NaN, C3. Compare means: if Shanghai > Wuhan then A, else B.
</thinking>

<code>
```javascript
const ee = require('@google/earthengine');
const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7');

async function runAnalysis() {
  try {
    // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
    const shanghai = ee.Geometry.Rectangle([120.8, 30.6, 122.1, 31.6], null, false);
    const wuhan = ee.Geometry.Rectangle([113.7, 30.3, 115.1, 31.4], null, false);
    const region = shanghai.union(wuhan);
    const start = '2020-04-20';
    const end = '2020-05-13'; // end exclusive to include May 12
    const fallbackStart = '2020-04-15';
    const fallbackEnd = '2020-05-17';

    // 2. Data Acquisition & Check with fallbacks
    const datasets = [
      'COPERNICUS/S5P/OFFL/L3_NO2',
      'COPERNICUS/S5P/NRTI/L3_NO2'
    ];

    function maskNO2(img) {
      const qa = img.select('qa_value');
      const mask = qa.gte(0.75);
      return img.updateMask(mask);
    }

    async function getUsableCollection(startDate, endDate) {
      for (const ds of datasets) {
        const col = ee.ImageCollection(ds)
          .filterDate(startDate, endDate)
          .filterBounds(region)
          .map(maskNO2)
          .select('tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density');
        const n = await col.size().getInfo();
        if (n > 0) return { col, n, ds };
      }
      return null;
    }

    let result = await getUsableCollection(start, end);
    if (!result) {
      result = await getUsableCollection(fallbackStart, fallbackEnd);
      if (!result) {
        console.log(`Dataset: None usable`);
        console.log(`Date: ${start} to ${end} (and widened)`);
        console.log(`C1: Empty Collection`);
        return;
      }
    }
    const { col, n, ds } = result;
    console.log(`Dataset: ${ds}, Images: ${n}`);
    console.log(`Date: ${start} to ${end}`);

    // 3. Processing
    const meanImg = col.mean();
    const ones = ee.Image.constant(1).rename('count').updateMask(meanImg.mask());

    // Pixel counts
    const pixSH = await ones.reduceRegion({
      reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(),
      geometry: shanghai,
      scale: 10000,
      maxPixels: 1e9
    }).get('count').getInfo();

    const pixWH = await ones.reduceRegion({
      reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(),
      geometry: wuhan,
      scale: 10000,
      maxPixels: 1e9
    }).get('count').getInfo();

    if (!pixSH || !pixWH || pixSH === 0 || pixWH === 0) {
      console.log(`Shanghai pixels: ${pixSH || 0}, Wuhan pixels: ${pixWH || 0}`);
      console.log(`C2: No Valid Pixels`);
      return;
    }

    // 4. Calculation
    const meanSH = await meanImg.reduceRegion({
      reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(),
      geometry: shanghai,
      scale: 10000,
      maxPixels: 1e9
    }).get('tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density').getInfo();

    const meanWH = await meanImg.reduceRegion({
      reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(),
      geometry: wuhan,
      scale: 10000,
      maxPixels: 1e9
    }).get('tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density').getInfo();

    // 5. Validation & Final Answer
    const invalid = (v) => (v === null || v === undefined || !isFinite(v));
    if (invalid(meanSH) || invalid(meanWH)) {
      console.log(`Means invalid: SH=${meanSH}, WH=${meanWH}`);
      console.log(`C3: Calculation Failure`);
      return;
    }

    const delta = meanSH - meanWH;
    console.log(`Shanghai: pixels=${Math.round(pixSH)}, mean=${meanSH.toExponential(3)} mol/m^2`);
    console.log(`Wuhan:   pixels=${Math.round(pixWH)}, mean=${meanWH.toExponential(3)} mol/m^2`);
    console.log(`Delta (SH-WH): ${delta.toExponential(3)} mol/m^2`);

    if (delta > 0) {
      console.log(`A: Yes`);
    } else {
      console.log(`B: No`);
    }
  } catch (err) {
    console.log(`Error: ${err.message || err}`);
    console.log('D');
  }
}

async function initEE() {
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject);
  });
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject);
  });
  await runAnalysis();
}

initEE();
```
